title: AutoGen v0.4: Actor Model and Agent Framework

questions.question: What is the only legal way actors interact in AutoGen v0.4?
options: Shared SQL transactions coordinated through a central database
Mutating each other's system prompts directly at runtime
Asynchronous messages exchanged through inboxes; no shared memory
Direct access to a shared dict that every actor can read and write
questions.explanation: Actors have private state and an inbox; messages are the only interaction.

questions.question: What are the three API layers of AutoGen v0.4?
options: Frontend, Backend, and Database layers
Tools, Models, and Memory subsystems
Plan, Act, and Reflect in a fixed loop
Core, AgentChat, and Extensions
questions.explanation: Core is the low-level actor framework, AgentChat is the task-driven high-level API, Extensions are integrations.

questions.question: Why does decoupling delivery from handling give fault isolation?
options: The runtime catches handler failures in B without crashing A; A's send() returned immediately and never blocked
Each actor runs on a physically separate machine by default, isolating every failure at the hardware level rather than in software
The runtime automatically restarts the entire operating system whenever a handler raises an exception
Every handler is written as a pure function with no side effects, so failures cannot propagate
questions.explanation: send() puts the message in the recipient's inbox and returns; a handler crash is local to that actor.

questions.question: Which AgentChat topology rotates agents in a fixed order?
options: SelectorGroupChat, which uses a selector agent to pick who goes next
RoundRobinGroupChat, which rotates agents in a fixed order
Magentic-One, the reference team for web browsing and code execution
Supervisor, a central router that dispatches to specialist subagents
questions.explanation: RoundRobinGroupChat is fixed rotation; SelectorGroupChat uses a selector to pick next.

questions.question: What is Magentic-One in this lesson?
options: A serialization format used for persisting actor state between separate runs
An OpenTelemetry exporter that ships spans directly to a tracing backend
A reference multi-agent team for web browsing, code execution, and file handling built on AgentChat
A new frontier LLM model released alongside AutoGen v0.4 specifically for benchmarking multi-agent performance at scale
questions.explanation: Magentic-One is Microsoft's reference team that demonstrates the AgentChat API.

questions.question: What is the lesson's stated status of AutoGen v0.4 in early 2026?
options: Deprecated and fully removed from Microsoft's GitHub organization
Replaced entirely by LangGraph as Microsoft's recommended framework
Just announced at a research preview event this quarter, with no production users yet
Stable but in maintenance mode; Microsoft Agent Framework is the forward path
questions.explanation: AutoGen v0.7.x is stable for research; active development has shifted to Microsoft Agent Framework.

questions.question: Which observability standard does AutoGen v0.4 emit by default?
options: OpenTelemetry spans with gen_ai.* attributes per the OTel GenAI semantic conventions
Prometheus metrics only, scraped on a fixed polling interval from every actor in the runtime
StatsD counters and gauges pushed over UDP to a local metrics agent
Datadog APM traces tied specifically to a Datadog-hosted agent process
questions.explanation: Every message emits a span; tool calls carry gen_ai.* attributes per OTel GenAI conventions.
